**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve claims with independent current citations**

When a deduplicated claim contains citations from multiple documents, reassigning or rejecting any one retained citation makes this helper return `False` and excludes the entire claim before its remaining citations are evaluated. If another current retained or public citation independently supports the same organization or role, the buyer/contractor consequently disappears and can produce a false material-removal event despite still-valid evidence; invalidate citations individually and retain or recompute the claim from its surviving support.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Filter retained evidence before applying the scan limit**

When more than 24 newer evidence rows remain historically linked to a project but now fail the new current-project predicate—for example after multiple retained-evidence reassignments—the SQL limit is applied before this filter, so an older still-current accepted version is never considered. A subsequent enrichment can therefore see no retained documents, write an empty buying-chain run, and silently drop retained-only claims even though valid project evidence still exists; apply the current-project predicate before limiting or page until four qualifying rows are found.
